projects.name: Ellendale HPC Campus
projects.quote: This will ultimately increase Ellendale's total HPC capacity to 400 MW.

projects.name: Ellendale 100 MW HPC facility
projects.quote: Applied Digital is in late-stage discussions with multiple hyperscalers to finalize a lease agreement for its 100 MW facility, which is currently under construction.

projects.name: Ellendale two additional HPC buildings
projects.quote: Additionally, we plan to bring an extra 300 MW online through two additional buildings currently in the design stage.

projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota data center
projects.quote: As of November 30, 2024, the Company’s 106 MW facility in Jamestown, N.D., and 180 MW facility in Ellendale, N.D., are operating at full capacity.
